actions.description: The terrorsaur makes one Bite attack and one Glaive attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Glaive
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Blowgun (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage plus 17 (5d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

reactions.name: Reptilian Escape (1/Day)
reactions.description: If the terrorsaur fails a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, they lose their tail and succeed instead. They regrow their tail when they finish a long rest.

reactions.name: Skulking Retreat
reactions.description: If the terrorsaur takes damage from a melee attack, they can move up to half their speed.

templates.name: Manticore
templates.languages: understands any one language but speaks only through the use of their Mimicry trait

traits.name: Agile Predator
traits.description: When the manticore hits a creature with an attack on the manticore’s turn, the manticore doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks from that creature for the rest of that turn.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: The manticore can mimic any words or phrases they have heard in a language they understand. A creature who hears the speech can tell it is an imitation with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The manticore makes one Bite and one Claw attack, or two Tail Spike attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature who is frightened of the manticore, they take an extra 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage, and the manticore can move the target up to 5 feet horizontally.

actions.name: Tail Spike
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of their next turn.

bonusActions.name: Trumpeting Howl (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: Each enemy within 120 feet who can hear the manticore must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the manticore for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). If the initial saving throw fails by 5 or more, a creature is also dazed while frightened in this way.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The medusa uses Stone Gaze and makes two attacks using Snake Bite, Heavy Crossbow, or both.

actions.name: Snake Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of the medusa’s next turn.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Stone Gaze
actions.description:
The medusa fires energy beams from their eyes at up to three creatures they can see within 60 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or begin turning to stone (save ends at end of turn). While turning to stone, a creature’s speed is reduced by 10 feet and they have disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws.
If a creature who is turning to stone is targeted by this action again and fails their save, their speed is reduced by another 10 feet and they are dazed until the effect ends.
If a creature who is turning to stone and dazed in this way is targeted by this action again and fails their save, they are petrified and can no longer make saving throws to end the effects of Stone Gaze. The petrification lasts until the creature is restored by a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher, a greater restoration spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

bonusActions.name: Nimble Escape
bonusActions.description: The medusa takes the Disengage or Hide action.

templates.name: Lady Emer
templates.skills: Athletics +8, Deception +8, Perception +7, Persuasion +8, Stealth +11, Survival +7

traits.name: Stone Sacrifice (3/Day)
traits.description: When Emer fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead by ending the effects of her Stone Gaze on a creature of her choice within 300 feet of her.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Emer uses Pinning Shot or makes three attacks using Snake Bite, Longbow, or both. She also uses Stone Gaze or Envenomed Stone, if available.

actions.name: Snake Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 17 (5d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of Emer’s next turn. While poisoned in this way, the target can’t take reactions.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Pinning Shot
actions.description: Emer makes three Longbow attacks against a creature touching the ground within 150 feet of her. If at least two of those attacks hit, the target is restrained by arrows pinning their limbs to the ground. A creature restrained in this way or another creature who can reach them can use an action to pull out the arrows and end the condition.

actions.name: Stone Gaze
actions.description:
Emer fires beams of energy from her eyes at up to three creatures she can see within 60 feet of her. Each target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or begin turning to stone (save ends at end of turn). While turning to stone, a creature’s speed is reduced by 10 feet and they have disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws. If a creature who is turning to stone is targeted by this action again and fails their save, their speed is reduced by another 10 feet and they are dazed until the effect ends.
If a creature who is turning to stone and dazed in this way is targeted by this action again and fails their save, they are petrified and can no longer make saving throws to end the effects of Stone Gaze. The petrification lasts until the creature is restored by Emer’s Stone Sacrifice trait, a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher, a greater restoration spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

actions.name: Envenomed Stone (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Emer utters an ancient hex. Each creature within 60 feet of her who is being turned to stone by her Stone Gaze must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Mesmerizing Eyes
bonusActions.description: The glowing eyes of Emer’s snakes gaze at one creature Emer can see within 60 feet of her. If the target can see Emer, they must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the start of the target’s next turn. A target charmed in this way must immediately use their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed in a direction of Emer’s choice.

reactions.name: Blinding Mucus
reactions.description: When a creature Emer can see within 5 feet of her hits her with a melee attack, Emer spits venom at their eyes. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) acid damage and be blinded until the start of their next turn.

templates.notes: Alignment: Lawful Evil. Role: Solo. Villain Actions: Emer has three villain actions. She can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy’s turn. She can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendaryActions.name: Villain Action 1: I See You!
legendaryActions.description: Emer uses Stone Gaze against each enemy she can see within 60 feet of her.

legendaryActions.name: Villain Action 2: Medusa’s Evolution
legendaryActions.description: Emer grows wings from her back, gaining a flying speed of 40 feet, then she moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks. After 1 minute, the wings crumble to dust and her flying speed is lost.

legendaryActions.name: Villain Action 3: Stone Puppets
legendaryActions.description: Emer mentally manipulates the stone in each creature who is being turned to stone by her Stone Gaze. Emer and each of those creatures move up to their speed then make a weapon attack against a creature of Emer’s choice (no action required).

templates.name: Mimic
templates.immunities: acid; bludgeoning damage from falling; prone

traits.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)
traits.description: While the mimic remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from an ordinary object.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: The mimic can imitate any sounds they have heard, including voices. A creature who hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 12 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, they are grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Gnashing Maw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage. If the target is grappled by the mimic, they take an extra 3 (1d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Shapechanger
actions.description: The mimic polymorphs into a Small, Medium, or Large object or back into their true amorphous form. Other than size, the mimic’s statistics are the same in each form. Anything they are wearing or carrying isn’t transformed. They revert to their true form if they die.

actions.name: Envelop
actions.description:
While grappling a creature, the mimic uses their Shapechanger action to polymorph into an object that is the same size or bigger than the grappled creature (if the mimic isn’t already in such a form). The creature is then enveloped by the mimic. An enveloped creature is no longer grappled, but they can’t breathe, are blinded and restrained, have total cover against attacks and other effects outside the mimic, and take 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the mimic’s turns. When the mimic moves, the enveloped creature moves with them. The mimic can envelop one creature at a time.
An enveloped creature can use their action to try to escape by making a DC 13 Strength check. On a successful check, the creature is no longer enveloped and is shunted to an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the mimic. The creature automatically escapes if the mimic uses Shapechanger or Panic Shift, becomes incapacitated, or dies.

reactions.name: Panic Shift (1/Day)
reactions.description: When the mimic takes damage, they release any grappled or enveloped creatures and then polymorph into a Small dense object with spikes, such as an iron ball or helm. While in this form, the mimic’s walking and climbing speeds are doubled, they have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks, they can only take the Dash, Disengage, or Shapechanger action, and a creature who touches the mimic or hits them with a melee attack while within 5 feet of them takes 10 (3d6) piercing damage. This effect ends when the mimic dies or uses their Shapechanger action to polymorph into another form.

traits.name: In Your Space
traits.description: The mimiature can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa, and the mimiature can move through any opening at least 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the mimiature takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the mimiature takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

actions.name: Sticky Swarm (Group Attack)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage. Until the end of the target’s next turn, they have disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple, and they have advantage on ability checks made to initiate or maintain a grapple. Additionally, if three or more mimiatures joined the attack, the target’s appendages become so sticky that until the end of the target’s next turn, they can’t cast spells with somatic components, they can’t drop objects, and they can’t interact with objects other than the ones they are already holding.

actions.name: Group Shapechanger
actions.description: The mimiature polymorphs into a Tiny object or back into their true amorphous form. If four mimiatures within 5 feet of each other use this action together, they can join together to become one Small object. Any-thing a mimiature is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed. A mimiature in object form reverts to their true form if any mimiature in the group moves, takes an action, or dies.

templates.name: Minotaur

traits.name: Dizzying Gore
traits.description: If the minotaur moves at least 20 feet straight toward a Large or smaller creature and then hits the creature with a Goring Horns attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be dazed until the start of the minotaur’s next turn.

traits.name: Minotaur Senses
traits.description: The minotaur always knows which way is north and can’t become lost.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The minotaur makes one Maul attack and one Goring Horns attack.

actions.name: Maul
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, the minotaur can push the target 5 feet away.

actions.name: Goring Horns
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Retaliatory Gore
reactions.description: When a creature the minotaur can see within 40 feet of them deals damage to the minotaur, the minotaur can move up to their speed. If the minotaur ends this movement within 5 feet of that creature, the minotaur can make a Goring Horns attack against them.

templates.notes: Alignment: Typically Chaotic Neutral. Role: Skirmisher.

templates.name: Minotaur Lackey

traits.name: Goring Run
traits.description: If the lackey moves at least 20 feet straight toward an enemy and then ends their movement within 5 feet of the enemy, the enemy takes 1 piercing damage.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the lackey takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the lackey takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

actions.name: Goring Horns (Group Attack)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 piercing damage. If this attack was made by more than one lackey, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be moved 5 feet horizontally for each minion who joined the attack. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 plus the number of lackeys who joined the attack.

templates.notes: Alignment: Typically Chaotic Neutral. Role: Minion.

templates.name: Ogre

traits.name: Defiant Anger
traits.description: When the ogre has half their hit points or fewer, they are resistant to mundane bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ogre makes one Spiked Club attack and one Fist attack.

actions.name: Spiked Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the ogre can’t use this fist to attack other targets. The ogre has two fists, one of which holds their club.

actions.name: People-Bowling
actions.description: The ogre throws one Medium or smaller creature they are grappling up to 30 feet horizontally. Each creature in the thrown creature’s path must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. After this throw, the thrown creature takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and falls prone.

bonusActions.name: Bellow (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: The ogre yells in the face of one creature within 10 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the ogre until the end of the ogre’s next turn. A creature who succeeds on their saving throw is immune to all ogres’ Bellow for 24 hours.

reactions.name: Violent Focus (1/Day)
reactions.description: If the ogre takes damage while blinded, charmed, frightened, or poisoned, they end these conditions on themself.

templates.notes: Alignment: Typically Chaotic Evil. Role: Brute.

templates.name: Ogre Goon

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the goon takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the goon takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

actions.name: Fist (Group Attack)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 bludgeoning damage, and if this attack was made by more than one goon, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and moved up to 10 feet horizontally. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 plus the number of goons who joined the attack.

templates.notes: Alignment: Typically Chaotic Evil. Role: Minion.

templates.name: Olothec
templates.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 20
templates.languages: Common, Deep Speech, Undercommon, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The olothec can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The olothec is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.description: The olothec has advantage on saving throws against supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The olothec makes six Devolving Tentacle attacks and uses Piscine Transformation.

actions.name: Devolving Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage. The first time a creature is hit with this attack on a turn, they must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be injected with a degenerative psionic slime (save ends at end of turn). While slimed, each time the creature makes an attack roll or an ability check, they must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the d20 roll. At the end of a slimed creature’s turn, the size of the subtracted die increases by one: the d4 becomes a d6, the d6 becomes a d8, and so on, to a maximum of d12. The cure ailment power or lesser restoration spell also ends this effect.

actions.name: *Piscine Transformation (3rd-Order Power)
actions.description:
The olothec targets a Humanoid they can see within 60 feet of them with a pulse of transformational energy. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or undergo one of the following transformations of the olothec’s choice:
Head. The target’s head transforms into the head of a fish, proportionately sized for their body. They can’t speak.
Legs. The target’s legs become fins. Their walking speed is reduced to 10 feet (unless their walking speed is slower), and they gain a swimming speed of 30 feet.
Torso. The target’s torso becomes the body of a fish with gills. They can only breathe water and can hold their breath for 1 hour. If the target isn’t underwater when this transformation takes effect, they begin suffocating. This transformation lasts until the target is affected by a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher or a greater restoration spell. A target who suffers all three transformations at once is permanently transformed into a hybrid fishlike creature and can only be returned to their original form by a wish spell or similar magic.

bonusActions.name: Jaunt (3rd-Order Power)
bonusActions.description: The olothec teleports 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.

templates.notes: Alignment: Typically Chaotic Evil. Role: Controller.

templates.name: Ithu’rath
templates.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 22
templates.languages: Common, Deep Speech, Undercommon, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Ithu’rath can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: Ithu’rath is immune to any power, spell, or effect that would alter their form.

traits.name: Slimy Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: When Ithu’rath fails a saving throw, they can succeed on the save by channeling the power of their protective slime. Until the end of Ithu’rath’s next turn, creatures have advantage on the saving throw for Ithu’rath’s Devolving Tentacle attack.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.description: Ithu’rath has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Ithu’rath makes six Devolving Tentacle attacks and uses Piscine Transformation.

actions.name: Devolving Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) piercing damage. The first time a creature is hit with this attack on a turn, they must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be injected with a degenerative psionic slime (save ends at end of turn). While slimed, each time the creature makes an attack roll or an ability check, they must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the d20 roll. At the end of a slimed creature’s turn, the size of the subtracted die increases by one: the d4 becomes a d6, the d6 becomes a d8, and so on, to a maximum of d12. The cure ailment power or lesser restoration spell also ends this effect.

actions.name: *Piscine Transformation (3rd-Order Power)
actions.description:
Ithu’rath targets a creature with a head, legs, or torso they can see within 60 feet of them, blasting them with a pulse of transformational energy. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or undergo one of the following transformations of the Ithu’rath’s choice:
Head. The target’s head transforms into the head of a fish, proportionately sized for their body. They can’t speak.
Legs. The target’s legs become fins. Their walking speed is reduced to 10 feet (unless their walking speed is slower), and they gain a swimming speed of 30 feet.
Torso. The target’s torso becomes the body of a fish with gills. They can only breathe water and can hold their breath for 1 hour. If the target isn’t underwater when this transformation takes effect, they begin suffocating. The transformation lasts until a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher or the greater restoration spell affects the target. A target who suffers all three transformations at once is permanently transformed into a hybrid fishlike creature and can only be returned to their original form by a wish spell or similar supernatural effects.

bonusActions.name: Jaunt (3rd-Order Power)
bonusActions.description: Ithu’rath teleports 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.

reactions.name: *Liquefy (3rd-Order Power)
reactions.description: When a creature within 30 feet of Ithu’rath hits them with an attack, Ithu’rath can psionically barrage that creature. That creature must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be pushed 5 feet away from Ithu’rath and be restrained until the end of the creature’s next turn, as their lower body temporarily melts into an immovable goo.

templates.notes: Alignment: Chaotic Evil. Role: Solo. Villain Actions: Ithu’rath has three villain actions. They can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy’s turn. They can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendaryActions.name: Villain Action 1: Skeletal Collapse
legendaryActions.description: Ithu’rath targets one or more creatures with a skeleton within 60 feet of them, attempting to temporarily melt their ligaments. Each target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and have disadvantage on Strength- and Dexterity-based ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

legendaryActions.name: Villain Action 2: Psychic Pulse
legendaryActions.description: Ithu’rath channels a pulse of telekinetic energy to scour and harry their foes. Each enemy within 60 feet of Ithu’rath must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or take 18 (4d8) force damage and be moved up to 30 feet in any direction.

legendaryActions.name: Villain Action 3: Slime Storm
legendaryActions.description: Ithu’rath unleashes a cloud of transformative slime. Each creature within 60 feet of Ithu’rath who isn’t an olothec or a slime servant must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 45 (10d8) piercing damage and is blinded until the end of their next turn as their eyes temporarily turn into insectoid feelers. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and isn’t blinded.

traits.name: Gnashing Horde
traits.description: If an enemy the blitzer can see starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more blitzers, the enemy takes 1 piercing damage for each blitzer within 5 feet of them.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the blitzer takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the blitzer takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Relentless Minion
traits.description: When the blitzer is reduced to 0 hit points while they aren’t incapacitated, they can deal 1 piercing damage to an enemy within 5 feet of them.

actions.name: Spear (Group Attack)
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

traits.name: Relentless (1/Turn)
traits.description: When the bloodrunner isn’t incapacitated and they are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, they can make an attack against an enemy (no action required) before the hit point reduction is resolved. If the attack hits and its damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the bloodrunner drops to 1 hit point instead of 0 hit points.

traits.name: Unimpeded
traits.description: The bloodrunner can occupy a prone creature’s space. The first time the bloodrunner enters a prone creature’s space on the bloodrunner’s turn, the prone creature takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage. When a prone creature in the bloodrunner’s space stands up, the creature enters the nearest unoccupied space of their choice.

actions.name: Spiked Shield
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the bloodrunner moves at least 10 feet before hitting a Large or smaller creature with this attack, the bloodrunner can choose to knock the target prone or push them up to 10 feet away.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Juke
reactions.description: When the bloodrunner makes a Dexterity saving throw, they can gain advantage on the save. To do so, the bloodrunner can’t be prone, grappled, or restrained.

templates.name: Orc Conduit
templates.resistances: determined by the conduit’s Affinity trait

traits.name: Affinity
traits.description: The conduit has a lifelong affinity for one of the following damage types: cold, fire, or lightning. The chosen type determines the conduit’s damage resistance and the damage of their Elemental Discharge and Power Burst actions.

traits.name: Relentless (1/Turn)
traits.description: When the conduit isn’t incapacitated and they are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, they can make an attack against an enemy (no action required) before the hit point reduction is resolved. If the attack hits and its damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the conduit drops to 1 hit point instead of 0 hit points.

actions.name: Elemental Discharge (Cantrip)
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) damage of the type determined by the conduit’s Affinity trait.

actions.name: Power Burst (2/Day; 1st-Level Spell)
actions.description: The conduit unleashes explosive energy in a 15-foot cone. The ground in that area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10 (3d6) damage of the type determined by the conduit’s Affinity trait, and they are pushed 10 feet away from the conduit. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn’t pushed.

bonusActions.name: Rush
bonusActions.description: The conduit takes the Dash action.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the forcecaller takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the forcecaller takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Relentless Minion
traits.description: When the forcecaller is reduced to 0 hit points while they aren’t incapacitated, they can deal 1 force damage to an enemy within 5 feet of them.

actions.name: Chainspoken (Group Attack)
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 1 force damage. If two or more forcecallers joined the attack, they can deal the same amount of force damage to another creature within 10 feet of the target.

traits.name: Relentless (1/Turn)
traits.description: When the fury isn’t incapacitated and they are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, they can make an attack against an enemy (no action required) before the hit point reduction is resolved. If the attack hits and its damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the fury drops to 1 hit point instead of 0 hit points.

actions.name: Haymaker Greataxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) slashing damage, or 12 (1d12 + 6) slashing damage if the target is prone. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Healing Rally (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: The fury regains 5 hit points.

traits.name: Relentless (1/Turn)
traits.description: When the garroter isn’t incapacitated and they are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, they can make an attack against an enemy (no action required) before the hit point reduction is resolved. If the attack hits and its damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the garroter drops to 1 hit point instead of 0 hit points.

actions.name: Strangle
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until the grapple ends, the target can’t speak intelligibly or cast spells with verbal components. If the attack was made with advantage, the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target falls unconscious for 1 minute (save ends at start of turn) or until they take damage. A creature can use an action to shake another creature awake who falls unconscious in this way.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. If the attack was made with advantage, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Cloak (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: The garroter magically turns invisible for 1 minute. Any equipment the garroter wears or carries is invisible with them. While invisible, the garroter’s movements make no sound. If the garroter hits a creature with an attack, casts a spell, or takes damage, the effect ends.

traits.name: Relentless (1/Turn)
traits.description: When the godcaller isn’t incapacitated and they are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, they can make an attack against an enemy (no action required) before the hit point reduction is resolved. If the attack hits and its damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the godcaller drops to 1 hit point instead of 0 hit points.

actions.name: Power Chord (1st-Level Spell)
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature who can hear the godcaller. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) thunder damage.

actions.name: Cadenza
actions.description: The godcaller chooses another creature within 30 feet of them. If the target can hear the godcaller, the target can use their reaction to move up to their speed and make an attack.

actions.name: Song of the Gods (2nd-Level Spell)
actions.description: The godcaller and each ally within 30 feet of them who can hear them has advantage on attack rolls until the start of the godcaller’s next turn. This effect ends early if the godcaller takes any damage.

bonusActions.name: Rallying Ostinato (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: The godcaller and up to three allies within 60 feet of them who can hear them regain 20 hit points, and these creatures ignore difficult terrain for 1 minute.

traits.name: Relentless (1/Turn)
traits.description: When the rampart isn’t incapacitated and they are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, they can make an attack against an enemy (no action required) before the hit point reduction is resolved. If the attack hits and its damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the rampart drops to 1 hit point instead of 0 hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The rampart makes two Spear attacks. If the rampart targets the same creature with both attacks, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than the rampart until the start of the rampart’s next turn.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

reactions.name: No!
reactions.description: When an enemy within 5 feet of the rampart targets another creature with an attack, the attacker must target the rampart instead.

templates.name: Orc Terranova
templates.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft., passive Perception 9

traits.name: Relentless (1/Turn)
traits.description: When the terranova isn’t incapacitated and they are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, they can make an attack against an enemy (no action required) before the hit point reduction is resolved. If the attack hits and its damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the terranova drops to 1 hit point instead of 0 hit points.

traits.name: Tremorspeak
traits.description: The terranova can sense anything a willing creature within 30 feet of them can sense with tremorsense or Tremorspeak.

traits.name: Unhindered
traits.description: The terranova ignores difficult terrain.

actions.name: Earth Pillar (1st-Level Spell)
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target touching the ground. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is knocked prone.

actions.name: Quake
actions.description: The terranova chooses up to five creatures on the ground within 15 feet of them and stomps the ground. Each target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Sinkhole
actions.description: The terranova chooses up to two creatures on the ground within 30 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be restrained. A creature can use their action to free themself or another creature within their reach, ending the effect on that creature.

bonusActions.name: Rush
bonusActions.description: The terranova takes the Dash action.

bonusActions.name: Unearth Mohlers (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: The terranova stomps, and 1d3 + 1 mohlers pop out of the ground in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of them. The mohlers are friendly to the terranova and act immediately after the terranova’s turn on the same initiative count.

templates.name: Mohler
templates.senses: blindsight 20 ft., tremorsense 40 ft., passive Perception 11

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Earth Bump
actions.description: As the mohler burrows under a Large or smaller creature on the ground within 5 feet of them, the mohler shifts the ground. The creature above them must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Ground Grinder
actions.description: The mohler burrows up to their burrowing speed. Ground within 5 feet of where the mohler burrows becomes difficult terrain.

reactions.name: Zip
reactions.description: If the mohler fails a Dexterity saving throw while burrowing, they succeed instead.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The scyza deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: War Harness
traits.description: While wearing a war harness, the scyza can carry up to thirty-six Medium or smaller creatures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The scyza makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage, and the target is knocked prone.

actions.name: Tail Whip
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is on top of the scyza, the target falls off and lands prone.

actions.name: Head Crest
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature who can hear, they are dazed until the end of their next turn by the crest’s deep ringing.

actions.name: Claw Twister (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The scyza claws at the ground in a flurry. Each creature of the scyza’s choice within 5 feet of them must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 13 (3d8) slashing damage, is knocked prone, and is blinded by a cloud of dust until the start of the scyza’s next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn’t knocked prone or blinded.

templates.name: Dohma Raskovar

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.description: If Raskovar fails a saving throw, he can expend a use of his Dohma Rally without gaining its benefits (no action required) and succeed instead.

traits.name: Relentless (1/Turn)
traits.description: When Raskovar isn’t incapacitated and he is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, he can make an attack against an enemy (no action required) before the hit point reduction is resolved. If the attack hits and its damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, Raskovar drops to 1 hit point instead of 0 hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Raskovar makes three Repeating Crossbow attacks or two War Mace attacks.

actions.name: War Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is dazed until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Repeating Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d12 + 1) piercing damage, and the target’s speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Reinforcements (1/Day)
actions.description: Raskovar takes the Dodge action, and ten orc blitzers appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of him.

bonusActions.name: Dohma Rally (3/Day)
bonusActions.description: Raskovar regains 20 hit points, and he gains resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of his next turn.

reactions.name: On the House
reactions.description: When a creature Raskovar can see within 30 feet of him fails an ability check or misses with an attack roll, that creature can reroll the check or attack, choosing either result.

templates.notes: Alignment: Lawful Evil. Role: Leader. Villain Actions: Raskovar has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy’s turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendaryActions.name: Villain Action 1: Close In
legendaryActions.description: Each ally within 60 feet of Raskovar who can hear him can move up to their speed. After this movement, each enemy within 5 feet of at least one creature who moved must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of Raskovar for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

legendaryActions.name: Villain Action 2: Lockdown
legendaryActions.description: Each ally within 60 feet of Raskovar who can hear him can make a Strength (Athletics) check with advantage to grapple an enemy within their reach (no action required). Then Raskovar can move up to his speed.

legendaryActions.name: Villain Action 3: Do It Myself
legendaryActions.description: Raskovar moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks. At the end of the movement, he can make up to five War Mace attacks with advantage.

templates.name: Otyugh
templates.senses: darkvision 60 ft. (see Adjustable Appendages), passive Perception 11

traits.name: Adjustable Appendages
traits.description:
The otyugh has seven adjustable appendages, which they can convert into other appendages using their Transform bonus action. In their natural state, the otyugh has one eyestalk, three legs, and three tentacles. These appendages grant the following benefits:
Eyestalks. The otyugh’s first eyestalk gives them darkvision out to a range of 60 feet and immunity to the flanked condition, and each additional eyestalk increases their darkvision’s range by 60 feet. If the otyugh has no eyestalks, they are blinded and lose immunity to the flanked condition.
Legs. Each leg gives the otyugh a cumulative walking speed of 15 feet.
Tentacles. The otyugh’s number of tentacles determine how many attacks they can make with Multiattack and how many creatures they can grapple with Tentacle Slam.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.description: The otyugh can magically transmit simple messages and images to any creature within 120 feet of them that can understand a language. This form of telepathy doesn’t allow the receiving creature to telepathically respond.

traits.name: Rot Leech
traits.description: At the start of each of the otyugh’s turns, each creature grappled by the otyugh has their hit point maximum reduced by 5 (1d10) for 1 hour. The otyugh regains the same number of hit points. This effect can’t reduce a creature’s hit point maximum below their current hit points.

traits.name: Trash Traversal
traits.description: The otyugh ignores difficult terrain. They also have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in piles of refuse.

traits.name: Vile Stench
traits.description: A creature who starts their turn within 10 feet of the otyugh must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of the creature’s next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The otyugh makes one Tentacle Slam attack for each tentacle they currently have (see Adjustable Appendages).

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be diseased with otyuck. A creature with otyuck can’t take the Dash action and their speed is halved.

actions.name: Tentacle Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 13) and restrained until the grapple ends. The otyugh can grapple one target for each tentacle they currently have.

bonusActions.name: Transform
bonusActions.description: The otyugh converts one of their Adjustable Appendages into an eyestalk, leg, or tentacle.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the dregsbelcher takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the dregsbelcher takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Trash Traversal
traits.description: The dregsbelcher ignores difficult terrain. They also have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in piles of refuse.

traits.name: Whetted Appetites
traits.description: While within 60 feet of the dregsbelcher, each friendly non-minion otyugh gains a +1 bonus to attack rolls. This bonus increases by 1 (to a maximum of +5) for each dregsbelcher in range of that creature.

actions.name: Regurgitate (Group Attack)
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/40 ft., one target. Hit: 2 bludgeoning damage plus 2 acid damage.

templates.name: Overmind

traits.name: Detached Eyes
traits.description: Six eyes float around the overmind and create their Eye Psionics effects. Each eye is an object that has AC 24, 1 hit point, and a psionic shield that makes it immune to damage. After an eye creates a psionic effect, it loses its psionic shield until the start of the overmind’s next turn. If an eye is destroyed, a new eye pops out of the overmind’s face to replace it at the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Eye Psionics
actions.description:
The overmind creates three of the following psionic eye effects. Unless otherwise stated, each eye targets a creature who the overmind can see within 120 feet of them. They can’t use the same effect twice in a turn.
1. Charm Beam. The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the overmind for 1 hour, or until the overmind harms the creature or one of their allies.
2. Compulsion Beam. The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed toward the closest ally they can see and make a weapon attack against them. Creatures who can’t be charmed are unaffected.
3. Toxic Vapors. The overmind chooses a point they can see within 120 feet of them. Each creature within 10 feet of the point must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).
4. Telekinetic Beam. The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be moved up to 30 feet in any direction and take 7 (2d6) force damage at the end of the move. Alternatively, the overmind can target an object they can see within 120 feet of them that weighs 300 pounds or less and isn’t being worn or carried, moving it up to 30 feet in any direction. The overmind can also exert fine control on objects with this effect, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.
5. Lightning Bolt. The overmind shoots a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line of lightning. Each creature in the line must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
6. Fire Beam. The targeted creature must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 36 (8d8) fire damage and catches fire, taking 9 (2d8) fire damage at the start of each of their turns for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). Any creature can use their action to douse the fire, ending the effect early.

bonusActions.name: The Great Eye (Recharge 6)
bonusActions.description: The overmind’s central eye turns solid black and projects a 150-foot cone of energy. If the overmind or any creature in that area is affected by a spell, the spell’s effects immediately end for that creature.

reactions.name: Away with You!
reactions.description: When a creature within 5 feet of the overmind hits them with a melee attack, the overmind can use Telekinetic Beam on the attacker.

templates.notes: Alignment: Typically Lawful Evil. Role: Artillery.

templates.name: Xorannox

traits.name: Painful Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: Eight eyes float around Xorannox and create his Eye Psionics. If Xorannox fails a saving throw, he can destroy a random floating eye (chosen by rolling a d8) and succeed instead. If an eye is destroyed, a new eye pops of out of Xorannox’s face to replace it 24 hours later.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Eye Psionics
actions.description:
Xorannox creates three of the following psionic eye effects. Unless otherwise stated, each eye targets a creature who he can see within 120 feet of him. He can’t use the same effect twice on a turn.
1. Charm Beam. The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by Xorannox for 1 hour, or until he harms the creature or one of their allies.
2. Compulsion Beam. The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to move up to their speed toward the closest ally they can see and make one weapon attack against them. Creatures who can’t be charmed are unaffected.
3. Memory Beam. The targeted creature must make a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, if the creature has unexpended spell slots, they expend a spell slot of their highest remaining level, with no effect. If they don’t have unexpended spell slots, they instead lose proficiency with a weapon they’re holding or carrying for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).
4. Toxic Vapors. Xorannox chooses a point he can see within 120 feet of him. Each creature within 10 feet of the point must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).
5. Telekinetic Field. Xorannox chooses a point he can see within 120 feet of him. Each enemy within 10 feet of the point must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be moved up to 30 feet in any direction and take 7 (2d6) force damage at the end of the move. Additionally, Xorannox can target any object within 10 feet of the point that weighs 300 pounds or less and isn’t being worn or carried, moving it up to 30 feet in any direction. Xorannox can also exert fine control on objects with this effect, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.
6. Lightning Bolt. Xorannox shoots a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line of lightning. Each creature in the line must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
7. Explosion. Xorannox chooses a point he can see within 120 feet of him. Each creature within 10 feet of the point must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
8. Necrosis Beam. The targeted creature must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or immediately take 55 (10d10) necrotic damage and lose 7 (2d6) hit points at the start of each of their turns. If this effect reduces a target’s hit points to 0, they die. The effect ends if Xorannox dies or can’t see the target. This psionic effect can’t be used again while this effect persists.

bonusActions.name: The Great Eye (Recharge 6)
bonusActions.description: Xorannox’s central eye turns solid black and projects a 150-foot cone of energy. If Xorannox or any creature in that area is affected by a spell, the spell’s effects immediately end for that creature.

reactions.name: Cower!
reactions.description: When a creature hits Xorannox with an attack, he shoots a psionic fear beam at them. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 21 (6d6) psychic damage and be frightened of Xorannox for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

templates.notes: Alignment: Lawful Evil. Role: Solo. Villain Actions: Xorannox has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy’s turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendaryActions.name: Villain Action 1: Disruption Beams
legendaryActions.description: Xorannox shoots a psionic disruption beam at three creatures he can see within 120 feet of him. Each target must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, whenever the target makes more than one weapon attack on a turn or casts a spell that isn’t a cantrip, they take 14 (4d6) psychic damage. This effect lasts for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

legendaryActions.name: Villain Action 2: Disappearing Act
legendaryActions.description: Xorannox turns invisible until the end of his next turn and teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

legendaryActions.name: Villain Action 3: Megabeam
legendaryActions.description: Xorannox unleashes the effects of all of his remaining psionic eyes at once in a 20-foot-wide, 120-foot-long line. Each creature in that area must make a save against two random eye effects from Xorannox’s Eye Psionics (reroll duplicates for each target). If the effect usually affects an area, it instead only affects individual creatures.

traits.name: Deadly Leap
traits.description: The owlbear’s long jump is up to 30 feet and their high jump is 15 feet, with or without a running start. If the owlbear leaps at least 20 feet toward a target and then hits them with a Bite or Claw attack, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.description: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The owlbear makes one Bite and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) piercing damage, and the owlbear can move the target 5 feet in any direction.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bear Hug (Recharge 4–6)
actions.description: The owlbear attempts to grab and crush a creature they can see within 5 feet of them. The target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage and is grappled (escape DC 15). On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and is not grappled. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 5 (1d10) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of their turns. The grapple ends if the owlbear uses Bear Hug on another target or makes a Claw attack against another target.

reactions.name: Hulking Rush
reactions.description: When the owlbear takes damage, they can move up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

templates.name: Shambling Mound
templates.immunities: poison; blinded, charmed, deafened, flanked, frightened, poisoned, prone
templates.senses: blindsight 120 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 10

traits.name: Engulfing Sack
traits.description: The mound has a vegetative sack on their body where they carry engulfed creatures. The sack can be attacked (AC 15; 50 hit points; immunity to poison and psychic damage), which deals no damage to the mound. Destroying the sack frees creatures trapped by the mound’s Engulf action. The mound regrows the sack at the beginning of their next turn.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the mound remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from an ordinary mass of vegetation.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mound makes two Vine Lash attacks. They can replace one attack with a use of Engulf, if available.

actions.name: Vine Lash
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, the mound can pull the target up to 30 feet toward them.

actions.name: Engulf (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The mound reaches out with writhing vines and attempts to pull in up to two Medium or smaller creatures within 30 feet of them. Each target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be engulfed in the mound’s engulfing sack. An engulfed creature is restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the mound, and takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the start of each of the mound’s turns. When the mound moves, the engulfed creature moves with them. If the mound dies or their engulfing sack is destroyed, each engulfed creature is freed and shunted to an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of the mound.

reactions.name: Poison Froth
reactions.description: When the mound takes damage, the inside of their engulfing sack churns with poison. Each creature engulfed by the mound takes 3 (1d6) poison damage, and the mound regains a number of hit points equal to the total damage dealt by this reaction to creatures in their sack.

templates.name: Shambling Pile
templates.immunities: poison; blinded, charmed, deafened, flanked, frightened, poisoned, prone
templates.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 10

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the pile remains motionless, they are indistinguishable from an ordinary mass of vegetation.

traits.name: Hungry Grab
traits.description: If an enemy starts their turn within 5 feet of three or more piles, the creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be grappled. While grappled in this way, the target is restrained, and at the start of each of the target’s turns, they take poison damage equal to the number of piles within 5 feet of them. The saving throw and escape DC equal 10 plus the number of piles within 5 feet of the creature. The grapple ends if fewer than three piles are within 5 feet of the creature.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the pile takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the pile takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

actions.name: Vine Lash (Group Attack)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 piercing damage.

traits.name: Tiny Target
traits.description: If the stirge is reduced to 0 hit points by any damage other than psychic while attached to another creature, that creature takes damage equal to half that dealt to the stirge.

actions.name: Proboscis
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 piercing damage, and the stirge can attach to the target and enter their space. While attached, the stirge moves with the target and can’t make Proboscis attacks. A creature who can reach the stirge can use an action to detach the stirge, shunting them into the nearest unoccupied space of the stirge’s choice. The stirge also detaches if they become grappled, incapacitated, prone, or restrained.

actions.name: Drain Essence
actions.description: The stirge sips the life essence of a creature they are attached to who isn’t a Construct or an Undead. The creature loses 3 hit points and must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of the stirge’s next turn. If the creature is already poisoned, they also become dazed until the end of the stirge’s next turn.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the broodling takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the broodling takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Tiny Target
traits.description: If the broodling is reduced to 0 hit points by any damage other than psychic while attached to another creature, that creature takes 1 damage of the same type.

actions.name: Proboscis (Group Attack)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage, and each broodling who joined the attack can attach to the target and enter their space. While attached, a broodling moves with the target and can’t make Proboscis attacks. The target or a creature who can reach them can use an action or bonus action to detach all broodlings, shunting them into the nearest unoccupied space of each broodling’s choice. The broodling also detaches if they become grappled, incapacitated, prone, or restrained.

actions.name: Drain Essence
actions.description: The broodling sips the life essence of a creature they’re attached to who isn’t a Construct or an Undead. The creature loses 1 hit point.

traits.name: Minion
traits.description: If the archon takes damage from an attack or as the result of a failed saving throw, their hit points are reduced to 0. If the archon takes damage from another effect, they die if the damage equals or exceeds their hit point maximum; otherwise they take no damage.

traits.name: Psychic Scar
traits.description: The archon is immune to any effect that would sense their emotions, read their thoughts, reveal they are lying, or reveal their alignment or location.

actions.name: Brutal Flail (Group Attack)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 bludgeoning damage. If two or more archons joined the attack, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be dazed until the end of their next turn. The DC for this saving throw equals 10 plus the number of archons who joined the attack.

actions.name: Blaster (Group Attack)
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 3 radiant damage.

traits.name: Psychic Scar
traits.description: The armiger is immune to any effect that would sense their emotions, read their thoughts, reveal they are lying, or reveal their alignment or location.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The armiger makes two attacks using Blaster, Serrated Saber, or both.

actions.name: Serrated Saber
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, and the target has disadvantage on their next attack roll made before the start of the armiger’s next turn.

actions.name: Blaster
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) radiant damage.

actions.name: Concussive Slam (1st-Order Power)
actions.description: The armiger rains down telekinetic force on a creature they can see within 30 feet of them. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or take 7 (3d4) force damage and be knocked prone.

reactions.name: *Sickening Sympathy (2nd-Order Power)
reactions.description: When another creature the armiger can see within 30 feet of them is hit with an attack, the armiger floods the attacker’s mind with the nauseous pain of their target. The attacker must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of their next turn.

traits.name: Precog Reflexes
traits.description: The nemesis adds their Intelligence modifier (+4) to initiative rolls and to their AC (included in Armor Class).

traits.name: Psychic Scar
traits.description: The nemesis is immune to any effect that would sense their emotions, read their thoughts, reveal they are lying, or reveal their alignment or location.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nemesis makes two Golden Scythe attacks. They can replace one attack with a use of Kinetic Crush or Phase, if available.

actions.name: Golden Scythe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage. If this attack reduces a creature who is in an astral body (as with the astral projection spell) to 0 hit points, that creature’s soul returns to their material body, and then their material body is also reduced to 0 hit points.

actions.name: Kinetic Crush (4th-Order Power)
actions.description: The nemesis attempts to telekinetically grip one creature they can see within 60 feet of them. The target must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 27 (6d8) force damage, and their speed becomes 0 until the start of the nemesis’s next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and their speed isn’t reduced.

actions.name: *Phase (1/Day; 4th-Order Power; Concentration)
actions.description: For 1 minute, the nemesis can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The nemesis takes 5 (1d10) force damage if they end their turn inside an object. If this power ends while the nemesis is inside an object, they are shunted out of the object into the nearest unoccupied space of their choice.

bonusActions.name: Jaunt (3/Day; 3rd-Order Power)
bonusActions.description: The nemesis teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space they can see.

templates.name: Time Raider Vertex
templates.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 19

traits.name: Psychic Scar
traits.description: The vertex is immune to any effect that would sense their emotions, read their thoughts, reveal they are lying, or reveal their alignment or location.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vertex makes two Psionic Slam attacks.

actions.name: Psionic Slam
actions.description: Melee Power Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage, and the next attack roll against the target made before the start of the vertex’s next turn has advantage.

actions.name: Split Space (2/Day)
actions.description: The vertex chooses a point in a precise location they have seen (in person or otherwise) on any plane of existence. A shimmering 10-foot-diameter portal leading to that location appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the vertex. Each creature who touches the portal is instantly teleported to the nearest unoccupied space at the chosen location. The portal lasts until the vertex dies, uses this action again, dismisses the portal as an action, or is transported by the portal.

bonusActions.name: *Invigorated March (3rd-Order Power)
bonusActions.description: The vertex emits invigorating psionic energy. Each time raider within 60 feet of the vertex can use their reaction to move up to half their speed.

reactions.name: Kinetic Defense Field
reactions.description: When another Medium or smaller creature the vertex can see within 120 feet of them takes damage, that damage is reduced by 15.

templates.name: Goxomoc
templates.immunities: fire, lightning, poison, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks; blinded, charmed, dazed, flanked, frightened, poisoned, paralyzed, petrified, stunned
templates.languages: understands all languages but can’t speak, telepathy 150 ft.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Goxomoc can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Earthbinder
traits.description: Enemies within 60 feet of Goxomoc can’t fly, and when Goxomoc moves within 60 feet of a flying enemy, the enemy falls.

traits.name: Lightning Lord
traits.description: If Goxomoc is reduced to 0 hit points, he sheds his flesh form and becomes Xogomoc. Any conditions or other supernatural effects that were affecting Goxomoc continue affecting Xogomoc.

traits.name: Psionic Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Goxomoc fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead, and he can’t use Energy Eyes or Shockwave until the end of his next turn.

traits.name: Psionic Weapons
traits.description: Goxomoc’s weapon attacks are psionic.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: Goxomoc deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Goxomoc makes one Bite attack, two Claw attacks, and one Stomp attack, and he uses Energy Eyes.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 20). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and Goxomoc can’t bite another target. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 hit points, they die and Goxomoc consumes their remains.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (2d10 + 10) slashing damage, and Goxomoc moves the target up to 10 feet horizontally.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target who isn’t grappled by Goxomoc. Hit: 23 (2d12 + 10) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Huge or smaller, they are knocked prone.

actions.name: *Energy Eyes (3rd-Order Power)
actions.description: Goxomoc beams energy from his eyes at a creature he can see within 300 feet of him. The target must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) fire or lightning damage (Goxomoc’s choice) on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Catastrophic Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Goxomoc breathes lightning in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 71 (11d12) fire or lightning damage (Goxomoc’s choice) and is teleported to an unoccupied space of Goxomoc’s choice within that area. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn’t teleported.

bonusActions.name: *Shockwave (2nd-Order Power)
bonusActions.description: A psionic shock wave emanates from Goxomoc. Each creature of his choice within 15 feet of him must succeed on a DC 25 Strength saving throw or take 22 (4d10) force damage and be pushed up to 20 feet directly away from him.

reactions.name: Volcanic Punishment
reactions.description: When Goxomoc takes damage, he teleports along with any creatures he is grappling in a burst of lava to an unoccupied space he can see within 30 feet of him. Each creature within 10 feet of the space he left must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

templates.notes: Alignment: Neutral. Role: Solo. Villain Actions: Goxomoc has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy’s turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendaryActions.name: Villain Action 1: Rumble
legendaryActions.description: Goxomoc stomps the ground, unleashing a wave of debilitating psionic energy. Mundane objects within 90 feet of Goxomoc that aren’t being worn or carried take 55 (10d10) force damage. Creatures within 90 feet of Goxomoc are knocked prone and must succeed on a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained and embedded in the ground. A creature can use an action to make a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, freeing themself or another creature within their reach on a success.

legendaryActions.name: Villain Action 2: Thunder
legendaryActions.description: Goxomoc disappears in a crack of thunder, along with any creatures he is grappling, and reappears in an unoccupied space he can see within 120 feet of him. Each creature within 30 feet of either the space he left or his new space must make a DC 27 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendaryActions.name: Villain Action 3: Eruption
legendaryActions.description: Goxomoc unleashes a psionic scream of anguish in the mind of enemies within 120 feet of him. Each target must make a DC 25 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 44 (8d10) psychic damage and then becomes vulnerable to all damage dealt by Goxomoc until the end of his next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and does not become vulnerable to damage.

templates.name: Xogomoc
templates.immunities: lightning, poison, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks; blinded, charmed, dazed, flanked, frightened, grappled, poisoned, paralyzed, petrified, restrained, stunned
templates.languages: understands all languages but can’t speak, telepathy 150 ft.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: Xogomoc can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Discorporation
traits.description: When Xogomoc drops to 0 hit points or dies, all conditions and other effects end for him. He teleports back to the place where he slumbers, transforms into Goxomoc with all his hit points, and falls unconscious.

traits.name: Disruptive Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If Xogomoc fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead, and his Lightning Aura doesn’t function until the end of his next turn.

traits.name: Lightning Aura
traits.description: A creature who starts their turn within 60 feet of Xogomoc must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Power of the Storm
traits.description: Lightning and thunder damage dealt by Xogomoc ignore damage resistance.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: Xogomoc deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.description: Xogomoc has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Xogomoc makes two Lightning Strike attacks.

actions.name: Lightning Strike
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +19 to hit, reach 15 ft. or range 600 ft., one target. Hit: 29 (3d12 + 10) lightning damage, and another target within 30 feet of the first must succeed on a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage.

actions.name: Energy Flow
actions.description: Xogomoc moves up to his speed without provoking opportunity attacks. During this move, he can move through the spaces of other creatures, and it doesn’t count as difficult terrain. The first time he moves through each creature’s space, that creature takes 22 (4d10) lightning damage.

actions.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Xogomoc breathes lightning in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 71 (11d12) lightning damage and can’t take reactions until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

bonusActions.name: Gone in a Flash
bonusActions.description: Xogomoc teleports, along with any creatures inside him (see Into the Storm), up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. Each creature within 10 feet of the space he left must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Shock Cage
reactions.description: When a creature Xogomoc can see within 30 feet of him hits him with an attack, he encircles the attacker in bands of lightning. The creature takes 22 (4d10) lightning damage and is restrained until the end of their next turn.

templates.notes: Alignment: Neutral. Role: Solo. Villain Actions: Xogomoc has three villain actions. He can take each action once during an encounter after an enemy’s turn. He can take these actions in any order but can use only one per round.

legendaryActions.name: Villain Action 1: Thunderstruck
legendaryActions.description: Xogomoc summons an awe-inspiring clap of thunder. Each creature within 120 feet of him who can hear him must succeed on a DC 25 Wisdom saving throw or be dazed for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

legendaryActions.name: Villain Action 2: Into the Storm
legendaryActions.description: Xogomoc summons tempest winds that buffet each enemy he can see within 30 feet of him. Each target must make a DC 25 Strength saving throw. On a successful save, a creature takes 16 (3d10) lightning damage. On a failed save, a creature is drawn inside Xogomoc. While inside Xogomoc, a creature is restrained, moves with Xogomoc, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside Xogomoc, and takes 16 (3d10) lightning damage plus 16 (3d10) thunder damage at the start of each of their turns. A creature inside Xogomoc can use an action to make a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check to move out of Xogomoc, entering an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of Xogomoc on a success. If Xogomoc takes 60 or more damage on a single turn or is reduced to 0 hit points, each creature inside of Xogomoc is shunted out of him into an unoccupied space of their choice within 5 feet of Xogomoc.

legendaryActions.name: Villain Action 3: Behold True Power
legendaryActions.description: Xogomoc unleashes lighting and wind in a chaotic storm. Each enemy within 120 feet of him must make a DC 25 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 44 (8d10) lightning damage and is moved up to 60 feet in any direction. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn’t moved.

templates.name: Kraken
templates.immunities: cold, lightning, psychic, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks; blinded, charmed, dazed, flanked, frightened, poisoned, paralyzed, petrified, stunned
templates.senses: blindsight 120 ft., truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 24
templates.languages: understands all languages but can’t speak, telepathy 150 ft.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The Kraken can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Discorporation
traits.description: When the Kraken drops to 0 hit points or dies, all conditions and other effects end for them. They teleport back to the place where they slumber, return to life with all their hit points, and fall unconscious.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The Kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Slowed Resistance (3/Day)
