bonusActions.description: Each enemy within 10 feet of the Horror who can hear the Horror must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the Horror for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). If a creature’s saving throw is successful or the effect ends for them, the creature is immune to the Horror’s Valor’s Death for 24 hours.

traits.name: Boog Rampage
traits.description: If Boog sees another Abomination reduced to 0 hit points, Boog rampages for 1 minute. While rampaging, Boog’s melee attacks deal an extra 2 damage.

traits.name: Boog Charge
traits.description: If Boog moves at least 10 feet straight toward a Medium or smaller creature and then hits them with a Gore attack on the same turn, the target is impaled on Boog’s horn and is grappled (escape DC 15). While grappled in this way, the target is restrained and takes 3 (1d6) piercing damage at the start of each of their turns, and Boog can’t make a Gore attack against another target.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Boog makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage or 12 (1d10 + 7) if rampaging.

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage or 10 (1d6 + 7) if rampaging.

actions.name: Boog’s Ball
actions.description: Boog throws a 3-inch-radius magic ball at a point they can see within 60 feet of them. If that point is 30 feet or less from Boog, the ball grows to a 5-foot radius. If that point is more than 30 feet from Boog, the ball grows to a 10-foot radius. Each creature in the ball’s area when it reaches that point must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage. After the ball reaches that point, it shrinks back to its 3-inch radius and teleports into the hand Boog used to throw it.

traits.name: Octopodan Camouflage
traits.description: Ceemal can attempt to hide even when they are only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, or other natural phenomena.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Ceemal makes two Fillet Knife or two Acid Spit attacks.

actions.name: Fillet Knife
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, another Abomination within 5 feet of the target regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

actions.name: Acid Spit
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/40 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) acid damage, and the target is poisoned until the start of Ceemal’s next turn.

bonusActions.name: To Me, Sweetie (3/Day)
bonusActions.description: Ceemal chooses an ally within 30 feet of them who can hear them. The ally can use their reaction to move up to their speed toward Ceemal without provoking opportunity attacks.

reactions.name: Wail of Loss
reactions.description: When another Abomination who Ceemal can see is reduced to 0 hit points by an enemy within 60 feet of Ceemal, Ceemal releases a psychic wail. The enemy must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Excess can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Excess makes one Bite attack and one Sting attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are grappled (escape DC 14). While grappled, a target takes 2 (1d4) poison damage at the start of each of Excess’s turns, and Excess can’t make a Bite attack against another target.

actions.name: Sting
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: Excess makes a Bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature who they are grappling or hidden from. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed as Excess enlarges their head and stomach. The swallowed target is no longer grappled, but they are blinded and restrained, have total cover against attacks and other effects outside Excess, and take 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of Excess’s turns. Excess can have only one target swallowed at a time. If Excess dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by them and can escape from the corpse by using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.description: Excess takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Klar can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: Klar can mimic animal sounds. A creature who hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) check.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: Klar’s long jump is up to 40 feet and their high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Klar makes one Bite attack and one Mantis Claws attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Mantis Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, they are grappled (escape DC 14). While grappled in this way, the target is restrained. Moving while grappling a Medium or smaller target doesn’t halve Klar’s speed. Klar can have only one target grappled in this way at a time.

bonusActions.name: Bellowing Roar (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: Klar lets loose a terrifying roar. Each creature within 30 feet of Klar who can hear them must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of Klar for 1 minute. If a creature frightened in this way takes damage, they can repeat this saving throw, ending the effect on themself on a success.

bonusActions.name: Kangaroo Leap
bonusActions.description: Klar jumps up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: Sair doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks when they fly out of an enemy’s reach.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Psionic Bolt (1st-Order Power)
actions.description: Ranged Power Attack: +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) psychic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, they are pushed 5 feet away from Sair.

actions.name: *Mind Scream (1/Day; 3rd-Order Power)
actions.description: Sair psionically pierces the mind of each enemy within 30 feet of them. Each target must make a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is automatically stabilized.

traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
traits.description: When Erasmus makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Master Tactician
traits.description: At the start of a combat encounter, Erasmus chooses when he acts in the initiative order after all other creatures have rolled initiative.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Erasmus makes two Greatsword attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of I’m Right Here.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, they have disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than Erasmus until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: I’m Right Here
actions.description: Erasmus taunts a creature he can see within 5 feet of him who can hear him. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or use their reaction, if available, to attack Erasmus. If the creature attacks, an ally within 30 feet of Erasmus who isn’t incapacitated can make a weapon attack against the creature (no action required).

actions.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
actions.description: If not in the Cyst, Erasmus teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, he teleports to a place he has visited.

bonusActions.name: Mark
bonusActions.description: Erasmus chooses a creature he can see within 60 feet of him and marks them until the start of his next turn. The first time one of Erasmus’s allies deals damage to a marked creature on each turn, the creature takes an extra 3 (1d6) damage.

bonusActions.name: Reposition
bonusActions.description: Erasmus and each ally within 60 feet of him who can hear him moves up to 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
traits.description: When Athenodorus makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Spellcasting (Utility Spells)
traits.description:
In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Athenodorus can cast the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
At will: light, mending.
1/day each: divination, glyph of warding.

actions.name: Star of Iron
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, they are hexed until the end of their next turn. Whenever a creature hexed in this way makes an attack roll or saving throw, they must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw.

actions.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
actions.description: If not in the Cyst, Athenodorus teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, he teleports to a place he has visited.

actions.name: Unholy Fire (2/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
actions.description: Athenodorus calls unholy black flames from the depths at a point he can see within 90 feet of him. Each enemy in a 15-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinder centered on that point must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage and is moved up to 15 feet horizontally. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn’t moved.

bonusActions.name: Blessing of Ajax (2/Day)
bonusActions.description: Athenodorus chooses a creature he can see within 30 feet of him. The target regains 14 (2d8 + 5) hit points and Athenodorus can end one of the following conditions affecting the target: blinded, charmed, dazed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, or stunned.

traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
traits.description: When Cloak makes an attack, she has advantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Cloak makes two Shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage, and the target is poisoned until the start of Cloak’s next turn.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a creature who hasn’t moved since the end of Cloak’s last turn, the attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
actions.description: If not in the Cyst, Cloak teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, she teleports to a place she has visited.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.description: Cloak takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

reactions.name: You Should’ve Been Watching Me
reactions.description: If a creature within 5 feet of Cloak hits one of her allies with an attack, Cloak makes a Shortsword attack against the creature. To use this reaction, Cloak must be able to see the ally and the attacker.

traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
traits.description: When Avalla makes an attack, she has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.description: Avalla has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

traits.name: Spellcasting (Utility Spells)
traits.description:
In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Avalla can cast the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
At will: light, mage hand, message.
3/day each: detect magic, mage armor.
1/day each: detect thoughts, disguise self, sending.

actions.name: Lightning Lash (Cantrip)
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) lightning damage, and Avalla can move the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

actions.name: Iron Terror (1/Day; 4th-Level Spell)
actions.description: Avalla projects a terrifying illusion of the High Command to each enemy in a 30-foot cone. Each target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 21 (6d6) psychic damage and be frightened of each member of the High Command for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Iron Shackles (1/Day; 3rd-Level Spell; Concentration)
actions.description: Avalla conjures animated iron chains at a point she can see on the ground within 60 feet of her. The chains fill a 15-foot-square on the ground centered on that point and last for 1 minute. When a creature enters that area for the first time on a turn or starts their turn there, they must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained (save ends at start of turn). A creature restrained in this way takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage at the end of each of their turns.

actions.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
actions.description: If not in the Cyst, Avalla teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, she teleports to a place she has visited.

reactions.name: Escape Ring
reactions.description: When Avalla isn’t in the Cyst and an ally she can see within 60 feet of her drops to 0 hit points, she expends a use of Iron Ring and teleports herself to the Cyst along with each willing ally within 60 feet of her who isn’t incapacitated.

reactions.name: Spellcasting Feedback
reactions.description: When a creature Avalla can see within 60 feet of her casts a spell, she taps into the caster’s mind and sabotages their magic. The creature can choose either to cast the spell then take 3 (1d6) psychic damage per level of the spell cast, or to let the spell fail. If the spell fails, the creature’s spell slot is expended with no effect and their action is wasted.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: If Qar is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails.

traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
traits.description: When Qar makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.description: Qar has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Qar makes three Unarmed Strike attacks. If he hits the same creature with all three attacks, the target is dazed until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Iron Ring (2/Day)
actions.description: If not in the Cyst, Qar teleports to the Cyst. If in the Cyst, he teleports to a place he has visited.

reactions.name: No Survivors
reactions.description: When an enemy Qar can see within 40 feet of him drops to 0 hit points, Qar moves up to his speed. If he ends that movement within 5 feet of an enemy, he can make an Unarmed Strike against them.

reactions.name: Voice Stealer (3/Day)
reactions.description: When an enemy Qar can hear within 30 feet of him finishes casting a spell with a verbal component, Qar attempts to steal their voice. The enemy must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or be unable to speak for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.description: Anthracia has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Anthracia makes three attacks using Stone Touch, Missile Thorn, or both. She can also use Tree Teleport, if available.

actions.name: Stone Touch
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d8) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be restrained (save ends at end of turn) as their limbs become heavy. If this attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, they become stable and are petrified into a withered stone tree featuring their tortured likeness. The petrification lasts until the creature is restored by a cure ailment power of 4th order or higher, a greater restoration spell, or a similar supernatural effect.

actions.name: Missile Thorn
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +9 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Tree Teleport (3/Day; 5th-Level Spell)
actions.description: Anthracia touches a living tree. She instantly teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of another living tree within 500 feet of the first. Both trees must be Medium or larger.

actions.name: Wall of Poison (1/Day)
actions.description: Anthracia conjures an opaque wall of poisonous gas centered on a point she can see within 150 feet of her. The wall can be up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall lingers in the air for 1 minute and its area is heavily obscured. Each creature who is in that area when the wall appears or who enters it for the first time on a turn must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 26 (4d12) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures who don’t need to breathe automatically succeed on this saving throw. A moderate wind (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses the wall after 4 rounds. A strong wind (at least 20 miles per hour) disperses it after 1 round.

reactions.name: Sudden Quake
reactions.description: When an enemy moves within 15 feet of Anthracia, she creates a small tremor in the ground beneath her. Each creature within 15 feet of her must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

templates.name: Logger
templates.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 10

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.description: Whenever Logger is subjected to lightning damage, they take no damage and instead regain a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Logger makes two Slam attacks. If they are in a fury (see Nature’s Fury), they instead make three Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Entangling Vines
actions.description: Vines lash out from Logger’s body. Each enemy within 30 feet of them must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or take 9 (1d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage and be grappled (escape DC 17) and pulled up to 30 feet directly toward Logger.

bonusActions.name: Nature’s Fury (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: Logger enters a fury for 1 minute. While in a fury, Logger has advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, and they can make an extra Slam attack when they use Multiattack. If Logger ends their turn without damaging another creature on that turn, the fury ends early.

templates.name: Sylphise
templates.resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks

traits.name: Fey Countenance (1/Turn)
traits.description: When a creature who can see Sylphise targets her with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded until the start of their next turn (no action required).

traits.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
traits.description: Sylphise can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.description: Sylphise has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Sylphise makes three Claw attacks or uses Sibilant Whispers twice.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Sibilant Whispers
actions.description: One creature Sylphise can see within 60 feet of her must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.description: Sylphise magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Mundane World, or vice versa.

reactions.name: Too Slow!
reactions.description: If a creature misses Sylphise with an attack, she can move up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks from that creature.

traits.name: Elf Glamour (1/Day)
traits.description: When a creature targets Tuval-Uthriar with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by him until the end of his next turn (no action required).

traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
traits.description: Tuval-Uthriar has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.

traits.name: Wheel of Ire
traits.description: Each enemy within 30 feet of Tuval-Uthriar has disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than him.

traits.name: Spellcasting (Utility Spells)
traits.description:
In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Tuval-Uthriar can cast the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
At will: light, mage hand, message.
3/day each: detect magic, speak with animals.
1/day each: detect thoughts, find traps, pass without trace.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Tuval-Uthriar makes three Longsword attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage, or 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Call Lightning (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
actions.description: A magical bolt of lightning flashes down from the sky to a point Tuval-Uthriar can see within 120 feet of him. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Eye of Sunrise (1/Day)
actions.description: Tuval-Uthriar’s gauntlet emits a fiery explosion in a 30-foot cone. The explosion can be heard 300 feet away. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) fire damage plus 17 (5d6) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each structure and mundane object in the area that isn’t being worn or carried takes 35 (10d6) fire damage plus 35 (10d6) force damage.

bonusActions.name: Healing Word (2nd-Level Spell)
bonusActions.description: Tuval-Uthriar targets one creature who isn’t a Construct or an Undead who he can see within 60 feet of him. The target regains 8 (2d4 + 3) hit points.

traits.name: Cloak and Dagger
traits.description: While Vali is hidden, he doesn’t give away his location if he makes a weapon attack and misses.

traits.name: Deft-Footed
traits.description: Vali leaves no tracks or other traces of his presence unless he wants to.

traits.name: Elf Glamour (1/Day)
traits.description: When a creature targets Vali with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by him until the end of his next turn (no action required).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Vali makes two Shortsword attacks, or he makes two Waning Moon attacks and uses Waning Moon Fade, if available.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Waning Moon
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is a creature who can’t see Vali, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) force damage.

actions.name: Waning Moon Fade (1/Day)
actions.description: Vali becomes invisible for 1 minute and takes the Hide action. This invisibility ends if Vali makes an attack, casts a spell, or manifests a power.

bonusActions.name: Nimble Escape
bonusActions.description: Vali takes the Disengage or Hide action.

templates.name: Harlo Honeygrin
templates.skills: Acrobatics +8, Arcana +9, Deception +12, Insight +4, Intimidation +9, Performance +12, Persuasion +9, Stealth +8
templates.resistances: none (bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks with Shadow Form)
templates.languages: Common, Dwarvish, Elvish, Halfling, thieves’ cant, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Amethyst Die (3/Day) Fear Resistant
traits.description: . When Harlo makes an ability check, saving throw, or attack roll, he can roll a d6 and add the number rolled to the number rolled on the d20 roll. He then takes psychic damage equal to twice the number rolled on the d6. Harlo can use this die even in his shadow form. Harlo has advantage on saving throws he makes to avoid or end the frightened condition on himself.

traits.name: Mind Link
traits.description: Harlo can communicate telepathically with any Amethyst Knife boss regardless of distance, provided they are on the same plane of existence.

traits.name: Telepathic Shroud
traits.description: Harlo is immune to any effect that would sense his emotions or read his thoughts, as well as to all divination spells.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Harlo makes two Mind Splinter attacks.

actions.name: *Mind Splinter (1st-Order Power)
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Power Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) psychic damage, and Harlo is invisible to the target until the start of his next turn.

actions.name: Shadow Form (1/Day; 4th-Order Power; Concentration)
actions.description:
Harlo transforms his body into an amorphous shadow, along with everything he is wearing or carrying, and gains the following benefits for 10 minutes:
• He has a flying speed of 60 feet.
• He has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks.
• He has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can attempt to hide without cover.
• He can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. While in this form, Harlo can’t pick up or wield objects
except for his Amethyst Die.

bonusActions.name: I’m Over Here
bonusActions.description: Harlo chooses an enemy within 60 feet of him who he can see but who can’t see him. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or make a weapon attack against a creature of Harlo’s choice.

bonusActions.name: Sneaky
bonusActions.description: Harlo takes the Hide action.

reactions.name: Shared Condition
reactions.description: When Harlo is blinded, charmed, dazed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, or stunned, he chooses a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 feet of him who doesn’t already have the condition or is immune to it. The chosen creature then gains the condition for the duration, and Harlo loses the condition. He can use this reaction even while incapacitated.

templates.name: Jutkarr Flintfingers
templates.languages: Common, Dwarvish, thieves’ cant, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Mind Link
traits.description: Jutkarr can communicate telepathically with any Amethyst Knife boss regardless of distance, provided they are on the same plane of existence.

traits.name: Poison Resistant
traits.description: Jutkarr has advantage on saving throws he makes to avoid or end the poisoned condition on himself.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Jutkarr makes two Deserved Transfer attacks.

actions.name: *Deserved Transfer (2nd-Order Power)
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Power Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) psychic damage, and one creature Jutkarr can see within 30 feet of him gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

actions.name: Psionic Resilience (2/Day; 4th-Order Power)
actions.description: Jutkarr touches a willing creature and gives them immunity to one of the following conditions for 1 hour: blinded, charmed, dazed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, or stunned. Additionally, if the target suffers from the chosen condition, that condition is suppressed for 1 hour.

reactions.name: Shared Condition
reactions.description: When Jutkarr is blinded, charmed, dazed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, or stunned, he chooses a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 feet of him who doesn’t already have the condition or is immune to it. The chosen creature then gains the condition for the duration, and Jutkarr loses the condition. He can use this reaction even while incapacitated.

traits.name: Deadly Sharpshooter
traits.description: Attacking at long range with a ranged weapon doesn’t impose disadvantage on Llyvessa’s attack rolls.

traits.name: Elf Glamour (1/Day)
traits.description: When a creature targets Llyvessa with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by her until the end of her next turn (no action required).

traits.name: Mind Link
traits.description: Llyvessa can communicate telepathically with any Amethyst Knife boss regardless of distance, provided they are on the same plane of existence.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Llyvessa makes two Scimitar or Longbow attacks. Alternatively, she makes one Longbow attack and uses Psychic Shot, if available.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Psychic Shot (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Llyvessa makes a Longbow attack that ignores cover, and which can pass through mundane solid objects up to 5 feet thick that aren’t being worn or carried.

bonusActions.name: Jaunt (1/Day; 3rd-Order Power)
bonusActions.description: Llyvessa or one willing creature within 5 feet of her teleports to an unoccupied space Llyvessa can see within 30 feet of her.

reactions.name: *Control Projectiles (3/Day; 2nd-Order Power)
reactions.description: When a creature Llyvessa can see within 60 feet of her makes a ranged weapon attack, she gives the creature advantage or disadvantage on the attack roll (her choice).

reactions.name: Shared Condition
reactions.description: When Llyvessa is blinded, charmed, dazed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, or stunned, she chooses a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 feet of her who doesn’t already have the condition or is immune to it. The chosen creature then gains the condition for the duration, and Llyvessa loses the condition. She can use this reaction even while incapacitated.

traits.name: Charm Resistant
traits.description: Treyvan has advantage on saving throws he makes to avoid or end the charmed condition on himself.

traits.name: Mind Link
traits.description: Treyvan can communicate telepathically with any Amethyst Knife boss regardless of distance, provided they are on the same plane of existence.

traits.name: Telekinetic Bastion
traits.description: Each ally within 20 feet of Treyvan has a +2 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws. Enemies treat the area within 20 feet of Treyvan as difficult terrain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Treyvan makes two Maul attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of Telekinetic Throw or Choke, if available.

actions.name: Maul
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, Treyvan can choose to either knock them prone or push them up to 10 feet away from him.

actions.name: Telekinetic Throw
actions.description: Treyvan throws his maul with telekinetic force, making a Maul attack with a range of 30 feet. After making this attack, the maul immediately returns to Treyvan’s hands.

actions.name: Choke (2/Day; 5th-Order Power; Concentration)
actions.description: Treyvan telekinetically crushes one Large or smaller creature he can see within 30 feet of him. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). While restrained in this way, the target takes 14 (4d6) force damage at the start of each of their turns. If the target is ever more than 30 feet away from Treyvan or has total cover from him, the power ends early.

reactions.name: Shared Condition
reactions.description: When Treyvan is blinded, charmed, dazed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, or stunned, he chooses a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 feet of him who doesn’t already have the condition or is immune to it. The chosen creature then gains the condition for the duration, and Treyvan loses the condition. He can use this reaction even while incapacitated.

traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
traits.description: When Victory makes an attack, she has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Mind Link
traits.description: Victory can communicate telepathically with any Amethyst Knife boss regardless of distance, provided they are on the same plane of existence.

traits.name: Kinetic Buildup
traits.description: When Victory hits a creature with a melee weapon attack, her speed increases by a cumulative 5 feet and she gains one additional reaction until the start of her next turn.

traits.name: Psionic Wound (3/Day)
traits.description: When Victory hits a creature with a Mindrazor attack, she can attempt to inflict a psionic wound (no action required). The target must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or become vulnerable to psychic damage for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Victory makes three Mindrazor attacks and one Cheap Shot attack.

actions.name: Mindrazor
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Cheap Shot
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d4 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, Victory can choose for the target to either be knocked prone or gain one of the following conditions until the end of the target’s next turn: blinded, dazed, or deafened.

reactions.name: Shared Condition
reactions.description: When Victory is blinded, charmed, dazed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, or stunned, she chooses a willing Amethyst Knife boss within 60 feet of her who doesn’t already have the condition or is immune to it. The chosen creature then gains the condition for the duration, and Victory loses the condition. She can use this reaction even while incapacitated.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Argan has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Pervasive Magic
traits.description: Damage from Argan’s spell attacks ignore the target’s damage resistances.

traits.name: Spellcasting (Utility Spells)
traits.description:
In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Argan can cast the following spells, using Intelligence as his spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):
At will: dancing lights, mage hand, message, prestidigitation.
2/day each: detect magic, mage armor, sending.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Argan makes three Arcane Lance attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Lance (Cantrip)
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (5d6) force damage, and Argan moves the target up to 15 feet horizontally.

actions.name: Lightning Volley (3rd-Level Spell)
actions.description: Argan calls down lightning on up to three creatures he can see within 30 feet of him. Each target must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 21 (6d6) lightning damage and their speed is halved until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage and their speed is not halved.

actions.name: Fireball (1/Day; 7th-Level Spell)
actions.description: Argan sculpts a fiery explosion centered on a point within 90 feet of him. Each creature of his choice in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 42 (12d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonusActions.name: Misty Step (2/Day; 2nd-Level Spell)
bonusActions.description: Argan teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

traits.name: Charm Resistant
traits.description: Kishina has advantage on saving throws she makes to avoid or end the charmed condition on herself.

traits.name: Light Landing
traits.description: Kishina takes no damage from falling.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.description: Kishina’s long jump is up to 45 feet and her high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Kishina makes four Unarmed Strike attacks or three Throwing Knife attacks.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage, or 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage on a critical hit.

actions.name: Throwing Knife
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d4 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Painful Sprint (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Kishina moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks, hitting a pressure point on each enemy she can see who she passes within 5 feet of during this move. Each target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throwing or be poisoned until the start of their next turn. A creature who fails this save by 5 or more also falls prone.

bonusActions.name: Throw
bonusActions.description: Kishina attempts to throw a Large or smaller enemy she can see within 5 feet of her. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be moved up to 15 feet away from her and be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Shield (3/Day; 1st-Level Spell)
reactions.description: When Kishina is targeted by an attack or a magic missile spell, she conjures an invisible barrier of force. Until the start of her next turn, she gains a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and takes no damage from magic missile.

traits.name: Elf Glamour (1/Day)
traits.description: When a creature targets Ellan with an attack, power, or spell, the creature must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by him until the end of his next turn (no action required).

traits.name: Resolute Aura
traits.description: While he is conscious, Ellan and any allies within 20 feet of him who can see him can’t be charmed or frightened.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Ellan makes two Bladed Scepter attacks.

actions.name: Bladed Scepter
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).

actions.name: Command (2nd-Level Spell)
actions.description:
Ellan speaks a one-word command to up to two creatures he can see within 60 feet of him. Each target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on their next turn. The spell has no effect if the target is Undead, doesn’t understand Common or Elvish, or would be directly harmed by following the command. If the target can’t follow Ellan’s command, the spell ends. Some typical commands and their effects follow:
Approach. The target moves toward Ellan by the shortest and most direct route, ending their turn if they move within 5 feet of Ellan.
Drop. The target drops whatever they are holding and then ends their turn.
Flee. The target spends their turn moving away from Ellan by the fastest available means.
Grovel. The target falls prone and then ends their turn.
Halt. The target doesn’t move and takes no actions.

actions.name: Unholy Flame (3rd-Level Spell)
actions.description: Ellan conjures unholy fire around one creature he can see within 60 feet of him. The target must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 27 (6d8) fire damage and is enveloped (save ends at end of turn). While enveloped, a creature takes 7 (2d6) fire damage at the start of each of their turns. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn’t enveloped.

traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
traits.description: When Radlee makes an attack, she has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Sure-Footed
traits.description: Radlee has advantage on saving throws against being moved against her will or knocked prone.

traits.name: Tactical Vigilance
traits.description: Radlee has advantage on initiative checks. While she isn’t incapacitated, Radlee and each ally within 30 feet of her who can see or hear her can’t be surprised.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Radlee makes three Halberd or three Longbow attacks. Alternatively, she makes one Halberd attack and uses Backswipe.

actions.name: Halberd
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d10 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Backswipe
actions.description: Radlee swings her halberd’s shaft at a creature within 5 feet of her. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or take 16 (3d10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Protector
reactions.description: When a creature Radlee can see within 10 feet of her attacks one of her allies, Radlee can make a Halberd attack against the attacker.

templates.name: Scarlet Shadow
templates.skills: Acrobatics +10, Perception +8, Sleight of Hand +10, Stealth +13

traits.name: Assassinate
traits.description: During his first turn, Scarlet has advantage on attack rolls against any creature who hasn’t taken a turn. The first hit Scarlet scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

traits.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
traits.description: Scarlet deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Scarlet who isn’t incapacitated and Scarlet doesn’t have disadvantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Scarlet makes three Shadow Blade or three Longbow attacks.

actions.name: Shadow Blade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) necrotic damage. If a target is hit by two or more Shadow Blade attacks on a turn, they must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Razor Garrote
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, they are grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, they take 22 (5d8) slashing damage at the start of each of their turns, and Scarlet can’t attack another target.

actions.name: Umbral Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Scarlet exhales dark flame in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 28 (8d6) necrotic damage and is frightened of Scarlet for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn’t frightened.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.description: Scarlet takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

templates.name: Aronar Valkys
templates.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 21

traits.name: Charm Resistant
traits.description: Aronar has advantage on saving throws he makes to avoid or end the charmed condition on himself.

traits.name: Delusions of Grandeur
traits.description: Whenever Aronar is affected by an effect (such as the hold person spell) that allows him to make a saving throw at the end of his turn, he can also repeat that saving throw at the start of his turn. Additionally, whenever Aronar succeeds on a saving throw against an effect, he ends that effect on himself and any ally within 30 feet of him under the same effect.

traits.name: Sun Eater’s Grace (3/Day)
traits.description: When Aronar is within 30 feet of Athmia and casts a spell that restores hit points to another creature, Athmia regains the same number of hit points.

traits.name: Spellcasting (Utility Spells)
traits.description:
In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Aronar can cast the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):
At will: augury, thaumaturgy.
1/day each: hallow, raise dead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Aronar makes three Divine Mace attacks, or he makes one Divine Mace attack and one God Complex attack.

actions.name: Divine Mace
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the start of their next turn.

actions.name: God Complex (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (8d6) necrotic damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of Aronar’s next turn has advantage.

actions.name: Cure Wounds (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
actions.description: Aronar touches a creature and the target regains 21 (3d8 + 8) hit points.

bonusActions.name: Vainglory (3/Day; 3rd-Level Spell)
bonusActions.description: A creature of Aronar’s choice within 60 feet of him regains 15 (3d4 + 8) hit points.

reactions.name: Sun Eater’s Soul (3/Day)
reactions.description: When a creature Aronar can see within 30 feet of him is hit with an attack, he can halve the attack’s damage dealt to them.

templates.name: Athmia Valkys
templates.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 17

traits.name: Charm Resistant
traits.description: Athmia has advantage on saving throws she makes to avoid or end the charmed condition on herself.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.description: If Athmia is subjected to an effect that allows her to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, she instead takes no damage if she succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if she fails.

traits.name: Mental Assault (1/Turn)
traits.description: When Athmia hits a creature with her Soul Blade attack, she can assault their mind. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Intelligence saving throw or expend one spell slot of the highest level available with no effect. A creature who fails this saving throw but can’t expend a spell slot must instead spend 3 of their Hit Dice with no effect, or if they can’t, take an extra 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Athmia makes two Soul Blade attacks.

actions.name: Soul Blade
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (5d6 +8) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of Athmia until the end of her next turn.

actions.name: Psychic Frenzy (1/Day)
actions.description: Athmia clouds the minds of her foes. Each enemy within 60 feet of her must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or be dazed until the start of her next turn. Athmia gains 5 temporary hit points for each creature who fails this save.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.description: Athmia takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

bonusActions.name: Sun Eater’s Gift (3/Day)
bonusActions.description: While within 30 feet of Aronar, Athmia swaps places with him if he is willing.

reactions.name: Sun Eater’s Mind (3/Day)
reactions.description: When a creature Athmia can see within 60 feet of her makes a spell attack against her or casts a spell that requires her to make a saving throw, she can pierce their mind, and the next attack she makes against that creature is automatically a critical hit.

templates.name: Caithas
templates.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 21

traits.name: Forest Defense
traits.description: When Caithas is in forest terrain and is targeted by a ranged attack by an attacker he can see, the attack has disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Caithas makes three Scimitar or three Scaled Longbow attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: Scaled Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d8 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature who hasn’t attacked Caithas since the end of his last turn, he has advantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Manifestation (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Caithas calls on his connection with Qazyldrath, and the dragon manifests in Caithas’s space and exhales dark energy in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) acid damage plus 18 (4d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Additionally, that area is filled with magical darkness for 1 minute. A creature with darkvision can’t see through this darkness, and supernatural light can’t illuminate it. The manifestation of Qazyldrath then disappears.

bonusActions.name: Gaze of the Decay (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: Caithas chooses a creature he can see within 60 feet of him, magically marking them for 24 hours. While Caithas and the marked creature are on the same plane of existence, he always knows the distance and direction to them. Additionally, a marked creature can’t hide from him, and if the marked creature becomes invisible, they gain no benefit from that condition against Caithas.

templates.name: Draven Malas
templates.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 10

traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
traits.description: When Draven makes an attack, he has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Profane Sacrifice (1/Turn)
traits.description: When Draven hits a creature with a melee attack, he can sacrifice his vitality to empower the attack. The target’s speed drops to 0 until the start of his next turn, and Draven takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage.

traits.name: Spellcasting (Utility Spells)
traits.description:
In addition to any other spells in this stat block, Draven can cast the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):
At will: alarm, mage hand.
1/day each: glyph of warding, scrying.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Draven makes three Gloom Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Gloom Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d4 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) necrotic damage, and Draven can move the target up to 10 feet horizontally. If the damage from this attack reduces a creature to 0 hit points, Draven regains a use of Blood of the Dragon.

actions.name: Blood of the Dragon (1/Day)
actions.description: Draven boils the blood of up to three creatures he can see within 60 feet of him. Each target takes 33 (6d10) necrotic damage and must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn) and knocked prone.

bonusActions.name: Creeping Dread
bonusActions.description: Draven chooses a creature he can see within 30 feet of him in an area of dim light or darkness. The creature must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or move their speed in a direction chosen by Draven. A creature with advantage on saving throws against being frightened has advantage on this saving throw, and a creature who can’t be frightened automatically succeeds on it.

templates.name: Vivienn Dirroze
templates.resistances: acid, necrotic (bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing during Draconic Rage)
templates.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 11

traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
traits.description: When Vivienn makes an attack, she has advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.description: At the start of her turn, Vivienn can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls made during her turn, but attack rolls made against her have advantage until the start of her next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Vivienn makes three Godslayer Axe attacks.

actions.name: Godslayer Axe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (1d12 + 8) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage. If the target is a Celestial, they take an extra 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.

bonusActions.name: Draconic Rage (3/Day)
bonusActions.description:
Vivienn roars with the might of dragons, entering a rage that lasts for 1 minute or until she is incapacitated. While raging, she gains the following benefits:
• Her size becomes Large.
• She has a +2 bonus to weapon damage rolls.
• She has advantage on Strength ability checks and saving throws.
• She has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Ravenous Bite (Draconic Rage Only)
bonusActions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (1d12 + 8) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be frightened of Vivienn for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn).
